feature: Owner console isolated beta account invitations
user_visible_change: Owner enters an email and optional name/workspace name, creates a real enterprise beta account in an empty separate workspace, and copies its private password-activation link or a ready-to-send message. No email is sent automatically and no initial project is created.
web_impact: New responsive owner-console form and authenticated server action. The existing signed owner-console cookie is checked on every action before the admin client is constructed. Existing activation/password/login/project-creation screens are reused.
mobile_impact: Owner administration is intentionally browser-only; a phone browser uses the same responsive form. Native customer APIs, permissions and binary are unchanged. TestFlight distribution and native pilot enrollment remain the separate documented administration step; the form states this limitation.
shared_api_domain_database_impact: Shared provisioning service uses existing Auth, organizations, profiles and project membership contracts. No schema, RPC, RLS or role-grant changes. Service-managed app_metadata stores a stable organization UUID for retry recovery; user_metadata is not trusted for this decision.
offline_classification: Online-only: authentication and provider-side provisioning require connectivity. The button disables offline; controlled fields survive a lost connection or failed action while the page stays open. A restarted page does not retain unsubmitted owner form input. Retry with the same email recovers an already-started pending account without duplicating its workspace. No private field values or activation links enter localStorage, IndexedDB, public Cache Storage or an outbox.
permissions_idempotency_conflicts: New accounts receive profile manager, never platform admin, and no project memberships. Existing activated/unmanaged accounts, accounts with projects/memberships, shared organizations and changed profile assignments are refused. Auth email uniqueness, a service-controlled stable organization UUID, insert conflict recovery and compare-and-set profile updates protect retries and concurrent requests. Invitation tokens are returned only to the unlocked owner and are not persisted in application tables or logs.
installed_client_compatibility: Based on production commit 2d82288380f1384b399998aaea37e197f8746fcd. Released /api/mobile/v1 routes, auth, pilot controls, RailBot, shared packages, offline payloads and public/sw.js have no diff. No new mobile build or device queue upgrade is required.
web_mobile_verification: Administrative form verified in the browser at desktop and 390x844 phone width with no horizontal overflow. Customer native-to-web and web-to-native data flows have no changed contracts and were not re-exercised. Physical native-device acceptance remains separately tracked.

validation.focused_tests: 16 provisioning, email-only setup, isolation, concurrent retry, partial failure, trusted origin and gate tests passed; added to CI.
validation.browser_story: Actual form -> Next server action -> synthetic HTTP Auth/REST provider -> exactly one account and one enterprise non-demo workspace -> activation link and clipboard copy. Repeated submission retains one user/organization. Synthetic recipient link opens the existing password setup screen. No synthetic password was entered and no production fixture records were created.
validation.authorization: Direct local POSTs without owner cookie, with a forged cookie and with a foreign Origin were refused before provider writes.
validation.offline: Real browser network emulation disabled creation and preserved email/name/workspace fields; normal connectivity and viewport restored.
validation.build: npm run build passed after final form changes.
validation.action_inventory: 127 existing web actions remain covered; this does not declare full native parity.
validation.database_grants: Static repository checks and disposable local PostgreSQL preview/reset/legacy-defaults checks passed.
validation.pending: Recipient physical-device acceptance and individual TestFlight enrollment are separate from this web administration feature. Existing supported platform acceptance gaps remain in the mobile handoffs.

rollout: Deploy only this isolated feature worktree, preserving production environment and existing pilot identities. Runtime artifact/source/PR identifiers will be recorded in the release handoff.
rollback: Restore the preceding production deployment to remove the owner form. Do not delete accounts, workspaces, recipient projects or offline drafts as part of rollback; existing accounts remain valid.
tracked_gap: Native TestFlight/pilot enrollment remains manual through the procedure in docs/mobile/FIELD_INVITATIONS_SENT_20260923.md. Automating Apple distribution/native enrollment is a separate feature and is explicitly disclosed in the UI.
